{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# Identify duplicates and keep only the highest sample_seq for each patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count unique patients after deduplication (this is the number enrolled)
num_enrolled_patients = len(data_dedup)

print(num_enrolled_patients)"}
